answer.reason: The verses tell of Amalek's battles with Israel, which are events of the Amalekites that can be told with the region as the subject.

clauses.english: fought Israel at Rephidim and was beaten by Joshua
clauses.quote: Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

clauses.english: joined Midian in coming up against Israel
clauses.quote: the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east

clauses.english: was destroyed by Saul with the edge of the sword
clauses.quote: utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword

doubts: The record is marked as a place, but nearly all the verses speak of the Amalekites as a people, so the clauses follow the people.
NUM 24:24 is marked but concerns Asshur and Eber, not Amalek, so it was left out.
Verses in lists (PSA 83:7, 2SA 8:12, 1CH 18:11) and the curses and commands (NUM 24:20, DEU 25:17-19, 1SA 15:2-3) were not used as events.
